name: premiereremote
description: PremiereRemote - MCP, HTTP, and WS servers for Adobe Premiere Pro UXP
author: sebinside

scripts.build: pnpm run setup && pnpm run bundle
scripts.dev: pnpm run setup && nodemon --watch src --ext ts --exec "node scripts/generate-api.js && pnpm run bundle"
scripts.setup: pnpm run clean && node scripts/generate-api.js && cp -r static/. build/
scripts.prepare-packaging: rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install --prod && node scripts/prepare-packaging.js
